conviction_note: Findings sum to +3.1: the 10-Q shows two straight quarters of ~$18M gross prior-period testing revenue that the ~$122M Q3 consensus only partly carries, and the FY EBITDA guide implies H2 at roughly half of Q2's run-rate, so a beat and a raise look likely. Against that, the stock is at its 52-week high, +63% since the Q2 print and above the mean target. On those grounds the scaled number is p_up 58 on a 14% absolute move, i.e. +2.2. The 14% sits below the 15.8% option-implied move because ATM spreads are 46% of mid. It sits near the +14.7% the name moved on its one un-pre-released print this year (Q2); the two pre-released prints (Q4'25, Q1'26) moved -4% and -5%.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue $122.4M / non-GAAP EPS $0.24 (Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 2026-10-21, https://finviz.com/news/406024/caredx-faces-first-navdx-quarter-with-street-estimates-trailing-its-raised-outlook); Benzinga $121.9M / $0.21 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/CDNA/earnings-forecasts). Revenue sources agree within $0.5M; whisper EPS $0.27. Company FY26 guide $490-500M revenue, $66-78M adj. EBITDA (2026-07-30). H1 was $249.7M including ~$25M lab products (sold 2026-06-30), so the guide implies $120-125M a quarter in H2 and consensus sits at its midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest 6.59M shares, 4.6 days to cover (aggregator snapshot dated 2026-10-26, https://equibles.com/stocks/cdna/shortinterest). That is ~12.7% of the 51.7M shares outstanding on 2026-07-27 (10-Q). The August snapshot read 6.1M, 11.9% of float, 4.3 days, so the short has edged up. Baseline: 25-delta skew null (not computable); put/call open interest 2.0 on 10,773 contracts; event-implied move 15.84%, but the ATM spread is 46% of mid, so indicative only. Spot $72.26 at the 52-week high, +9.1% over 20 days, +406% off the 52-week low, above the StockAnalysis mean target of $61.67 (range $46-75). Moderately crowded short into a momentum high.

findings.finding: The Q2 2026 10-Q (Note 2) shows CareDx recognized $18.0M in Q2 and $35.6M in H1 2026 of revenue for tests performed in prior periods, partly offset by $2.4M / $5.8M of refund-reserve increases. Net that is ~$14M in Q1 and ~$16M in Q2, so it has recurred two quarters running. A Q3 build without it (58,000 transplant tests guided × ~$1,450 core ASP ≈ $84M, NavDx ~$11-12M, Patient & Digital ~$19M) gives ~$115M, which means the $122.4M consensus carries only ~$7M of prior-period revenue. A third quarter at the Q1-Q2 rate would put revenue near $128-132M, about 5-8% above the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (not pre-released): revenue $131.9M vs $114.1M consensus (+16%), with $16M prior-period revenue; stock +14.72% (baseline 2026-07-30). Q1 2026: $117.7M vs $102M consensus, but already pre-released on 2026-04-16 (+27.6% that day); the full print was -5.07%. Q4 2025: pre-released 2026-01-12 (+20.08%); full print 2026-02-24 -4.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits at the guide midpoint, not at the Q1-Q2 run-rate including prior-period revenue. If the street modelled the collections as recurring, Q3 consensus would be near $128-130M rather than $122M. The quality question (prior-period revenue may be discounted as low quality) is why this is sized below the Q2 reaction.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 release independently reports ~$14M of prior-period revenue (https://investors.caredx.com/news/news-details/2026/CareDx-Announces-First-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx). Shares the prior-period logic with the EBITDA-guide finding below; the two are counted separately because one lands on the quarter and the other on the guide.

findings.finding: The FY26 adjusted EBITDA guide of $66-78M against H1 actuals of ~$44M (Q1 $19M + Q2 $24.8M) implies only $22-34M for all of H2, i.e. $11-17M a quarter, against $24.8M in Q2 alone. The revenue guide likewise implies $120-125M a quarter ex lab products, below the ~$119M ex-lab Q2 plus a NavDx quarter. The guide therefore looks built with zero prior-period revenue and a conservative NavDx margin, leaving room for a fourth consecutive raise (Feb $420-444M, Apr $447-465M, Jul $490-500M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Every 2026 guide raise has come with a large move on the day it was first disclosed: the Jan 12 preliminary +20.1%, the Apr 16 preliminary +27.6%, the Jul 30 print with the $490-500M raise +14.7%. Raises that only confirmed a pre-release (Feb 24, Apr 28) were sold 4-5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The Earnings Whispers preview (2026-10-21) frames H2 EBITDA as 'far below the Q2 level', i.e. the street reads the guide literally. If a raise were priced, consensus FY EBITDA and Q3 revenue would sit above the guide midpoint, not on it.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview makes the same H2 EBITDA arithmetic independently (https://finviz.com/news/406024/caredx-faces-first-navdx-quarter-with-street-estimates-trailing-its-raised-outlook). Shares the prior-period driver with the finding above.

findings.finding: The final Medicare LCD for solid-organ transplant molecular testing (published 2026-07-16, effective ~2026-08-30) allows up to 6 AlloSure Kidney surveillance tests in year 1 and 4 a year in years 2-3, up from 4 and 2 in the draft, and 12 a year for heart/lung in year 1. CareDx removed a previously expected $7.5M Medicare headwind from its guide. Q3 carries one month under the new policy; Q4 and 2027 commentary carry the rest.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The LCD finalization (2026-07-16) preceded the Q2 print, which rose +14.7% on a raise that included the removal of the $7.5M Medicare impact. BTIG's 2026-09-24 note on management's post-LCD confidence came with a ~14% one-day gain.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock is +63% since the Q2 print. What is not yet in numbers is the volume and ASP uplift from expanded surveillance frequency, which management has not quantified. A quantified 2027 frame on the call would be new; if it were priced, sell-side FY27 numbers would already reflect higher surveillance frequency.
findings.independence: Natera (direct competitor, Prospera) said on its Q2 2026 call that the final LCD will benefit transplant volumes and ASPs in H2 2026 (https://www.tickerreport.com/?p=13537117). Medtech coverage of the final LCD: https://www.genomeweb.com/node/655691

findings.finding: Naveris (NavDx), acquired 2026-07-01, booked $10.8M revenue in Q1 2026 (8-K/A EX-99.2, filed 2026-09-16) and $34.3M in FY2025. CareDx's guide assumes ~$24M of specialty oncology revenue in H2 (~$12M a quarter) on 14,600 Q3 oncology tests at $770-795. The standalone run-rate already reaches that, so NavDx lands in line to slightly above. The 8-K/A also carries a going-concern note for standalone Naveris, which is moot under CareDx's ownership.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First quarter with NavDx consolidated; no history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The 8-K/A financials are not carried in previews. The contribution is small (~10% of revenue) and inside guide, hence the small size. The Q4 billing migration toward $1,000+ per test lands after the window.
findings.independence: Naveris FY2025 $34.3M audited statements (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1217234/000121723426000052/naveris2025financialstat.htm); same filing, so one source.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is stretched. Spot $72.26 is at the 52-week high, +9.1% over 20 days and ~+63% since the Q2 print, above the $61.67 mean analyst target (7 analysts, range $46-75). Whisper EPS $0.27 sits above the $0.24 consensus, and put/call open interest is 2.0. A beat in line with the last two quarters (+15-16% revenue) may already be what holders expect. Partly offset by ~12.7% of shares short (6.59M, 4.6 days), which is squeeze fuel on a clean raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints that only confirmed known numbers (Feb 24, Apr 28) fell 4-5% even with beats; the un-pre-released Q2 rose 14.7% from a lower base.
findings.why_not_priced: This finding is about what is priced: a stock above every average target with a whisper above consensus needs a beat plus raise larger than the last one. If expectations were modest, the stock would sit below targets and the whisper would equal consensus.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview (2026-10-21) gives the $0.27 whisper and the +63% since the last print (https://finviz.com/news/406024/caredx-faces-first-navdx-quarter-with-street-estimates-trailing-its-raised-outlook); short interest from https://equibles.com/stocks/cdna/shortinterest

findings.finding: Company Q3 volume guide: 58,000 transplant tests (72,600 total including 14,600 specialty oncology), flat sequentially versus Q2's ~58,000. That compares with Q1 54,900 and Q2 58,000 (+17% YoY each), so transplant-volume growth decelerates sequentially, against a backdrop of declining US deceased-donor kidney transplants since mid-2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Volume has printed +17% YoY in each 2026 quarter; there has been no volume miss this year to measure.
findings.why_not_priced: The volume target is public (raised from 56,600 to 58,000), so this is mostly priced. The residual is that ASP, not volume, is carrying growth, and a volume print at or below 58k would expose that.
findings.independence: Kidney transplant decline in 2025 (proxy, not company-confirmed): https://californiainsider.com/news/kidney-transplants-drop-amid-increased-organ-donation-oversight-5971994

findings.finding: EDGAR shows 17 Form 144 proposed-sale notices from insiders between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-17, right after the Q2 print, plus Form 4s on 2026-09-15 and five on 2026-10-05 (content not read). This is routine post-window selling into a +60% move; there is no open-market buy cluster.
findings.why_not_priced: Insider selling after a window opens is common and weakly informative; it is sized near zero for that reason.

findings.finding: BTIG met management in Boston in the week of 2026-09-22 and raised its target from $60 to $74 (Buy), reporting management 'confident' after the LCD resolution and strong core transplant growth. Canaccord initiated at Buy/$65 on 2026-09-02 and Craig-Hallum upgraded to Buy on 2026-08-03. The tone from management late in the quarter was positive, which makes a Q3 miss less likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock rose ~14% on the BTIG note day; already in the price.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced (the +14% day). The residual is that management spoke confidently with ~one week of Q3 left, which lowers the probability of a negative surprise, not the size of the upside.

outside_window.finding: NavDx billing migration in Q4 2026 aims to lift the realised price from $770-795 toward $1,000+ per test (Medicare rate ~$1,800). It shows up in Q4 revenue, after the window; only commentary on it lands in-window.
Natera's Q3 2026 print (organ health / Prospera read-across) is expected in early November based on its 2025 cadence (Nov 6, 2025), after the exit window.

baseline_tension: The documents point to a beat and a likely raise, which agrees with the momentum but cuts against a stock already at its 52-week high, above every average target, with a whisper above consensus and put/call open interest at 2.0. lessons_applied: Lesson 1/2 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; quality of the beat): the prior-period-revenue beat finding shrinks from +2.0 to +1.5, because a beat built on collections for prior-period tests may be discounted as low quality
Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks a negative): the positioning negative shrinks from -1.5 to -1.0 given ~12.7% of shares short at 4.6 days
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the bar is confirmed by two agreeing revenue sources ($122.4M / $121.9M) plus the company guide, so no cap applies; the stale $455M FY figure went to rejected_candidates
Lesson 3 (read the set): the two prior-period-driven findings are kept apart (quarter vs guide) with shared provenance stated; no contradictions found
Left standing: abs_move 14 and p_up 58; the pre and post sums are both +3.1 because the two resizes offset (-0.5 and +0.5)
